milestones.title: Verify component c01 at grouping level 1
Verify component c02 at grouping level 1

S1.instruction: Process c01 source records in their given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, and lowercase kind and status. Retain only records with status `ok`, nonempty record_id and client, kind `sale` or `refund`, quantity matching ASCII `[0-9]{1,2}` and in 1..50, and unit_price matching ASCII `[0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2}` with a literal decimal point. Skip invalid records without reserving their IDs; retain only the first valid record for each normalized record_id. Sort retained rows lexically by record_id. Compute unit_cents exactly from the decimal price and net_cents as quantity times unit_cents, negative for refunds and positive for sales; preserve kind and quantity.

S2.instruction: Using the completed c01_rows, group retained rows by normalized client in lexical order. For each client, count retained records and sum signed net_cents exactly as integers. Preserve the result as the required client/count/net_cents aggregate entries; do not use floating-point arithmetic.

S3.instruction: Using c01_aggregates, render the exact report with no trailing newline: first `CLIENT COUNT NET`, then one line per client in lexical order as `<client> <count> <net amount with exactly two decimal places>`, then `TOTAL <retained record count> <grand net amount with exactly two decimal places>`. Convert integer cents to decimal text exactly, with single spaces and a minus sign only for negative amounts.

S4.instruction: Check that c01_report and its declared prerequisites pass against the current c01 environment. Then provide the certification artifact with environment_revision equal to the current c01 component revision (currently 0) and checked_gates exactly ["c01_report"] in that order.
